summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed and no other files changed. Not verified: mypy and ruff are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and import order were checked by reading only. One deviation: the type-ignore for the lookup-argument error sits on the parse call inside the pytest.raises block, not on the with line, because the with line does not pass the optional value.
